verdicts.decision_note: The client specifies a four-layer PCB stack for the legacy main-board design.

ambiguity.description: The client proposes replacing the multi-board design with a single integrated board but asks whether the change should proceed, leaving the legacy main-board layer stack unresolved.

verdicts.decision_note: The single-board architecture would eliminate the separate main-board stack, but this source presents it as an unresolved proposal rather than a confirmed replacement.
The client confirms that only one integrated board remains, eliminating the separate legacy main board and its independent layer-stack requirement.
